parsed.internal_thinking: Gemma rolled a 9, which gives both of us 1 Wheat. I now have 4 Wheat and 2 Wood. This is good; if I can't trade for Brick, I can use 4 Wheat at the bank next turn to get the Brick I need for the road to the port. The atmosphere is still tense, so silence is best.
